COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.

   D. Work alone with eyes closed

16. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
